questionResults.question: Who has the lowest average 18 hole score?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, AVG(pt.front_nine_score + pt.back_nine_score) AS average_score
FROM player p
JOIN player_tournament pt ON p.player_id = pt.player_id
GROUP BY p.player_id
ORDER BY average_score ASC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Brigham Hale has the lowest average 18-hole score at 74.0.

questionResults.question: What team has the lowest average score across all tournaments?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT pt.team_id, AVG(pt.front_nine_score + pt.back_nine_score) AS average_score
FROM player_tournament pt
GROUP BY pt.team_id
ORDER BY average_score ASC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The team with the lowest average score across all tournaments is Team 3, with an average of 77.56.

questionResults.question: Which course is the hardest by slope rating?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT name, slope_rating 
FROM course 
ORDER BY slope_rating DESC 
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The hardest course by slope rating is Sand Hollow Resort, with a rating of 144.

questionResults.question: Which player won the most tournaments?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(pt.tournament_id) AS tournament_wins
FROM player p
JOIN player_tournament pt ON p.player_id = pt.player_id
GROUP BY p.player_id
ORDER BY tournament_wins DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Jake Anderson won the most tournaments with a total of 4.

questionResults.question: Which team had the best combined score at each tournament?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT pt.tournament_id, tt.team_id, SUM(pt.front_nine_score + pt.back_nine_score) AS combined_score
FROM player_tournament pt
JOIN team_tournament tt ON pt.team_id = tt.team_id AND pt.tournament_id = tt.tournament_id
GROUP BY pt.tournament_id, tt.team_id
HAVING combined_score = (
    SELECT MAX(SUM(pt2.front_nine_score + pt2.back_nine_score)
                ) 
    FROM player_tournament pt2 
    JOIN team_tournament tt2 ON pt2.team_id = tt2.team_id AND pt2.tournament_id = tt2.tournament_id 
    WHERE pt2.tournament_id = pt.tournament_id 
    GROUP BY tt2.team_id
);

questionResults.question: Which players withdrew before finishing a round?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.middle_name, p.last_name, pt.tournament_id
FROM player p
JOIN player_tournament pt ON p.player_id = pt.player_id
WHERE pt.front_nine_score IS NULL OR pt.back_nine_score IS NULL;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Ty Madsen and Hunter Pratt withdrew before finishing their rounds.

questionResults.question: Which seniors in the class of 2025 played in every tournament?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM player p
JOIN player_tournament pt ON p.player_id = pt.player_id
WHERE p.graduation_date = '2025-05-31'  -- Assuming graduation date is the last day of May
GROUP BY p.player_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tournament_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament);
questionResults.friendlyResponse: It looks like no seniors in the class of 2025 played in every tournament.

questionResults.question: Which players have played for more than one team?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM player p
JOIN player_tournament pt ON p.player_id = pt.player_id
JOIN team_tournament tt ON pt.team_id = tt.team_id
GROUP BY p.player_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tt.team_id) > 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Mason Fowler is a player who has played for more than one team.

questionResults.question: What is the average 18 hole score for each division?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT s.division, AVG(pt.front_nine_score + pt.back_nine_score) AS average_18_hole_score
FROM player_tournament pt
JOIN team t ON pt.team_id = t.team_id
JOIN school s ON t.school_id = s.school_id
GROUP BY s.division;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The average 18-hole scores are 86.0 for 3A, 81.94 for 5A, and 77.56 for 6A.

questionResults.question: Which players have never played in a tournament?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.middle_name, p.last_name 
FROM player p 
LEFT JOIN player_tournament pt ON p.player_id = pt.player_id 
WHERE pt.tournament_id IS NULL;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Noah Reeves is a player who has never participated in a tournament.
